datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly basis throughout 2015 (January, April, July, October) across Uganda. The classifications were spatially mapped to geographic units and stored in GeoJSON and KML formats, representing different IPC scenarios and phases of acute food insecurity.
